known.name: Reeve Ashcombe
known.aiDescription: The river-reeve of the gloamwater. Last spring she seized the eel weirs for the crown, and she now takes a copper from every crossing. She keeps her seat in the hamlet and rarely comes down to the water.
known.aiSummary: The river-reeve who seized the eel weirs last spring and takes a copper from every crossing.

cases.narration: The ferryman spits into the dark water. "Toll's gone up again," he mutters, not looking at you. The eel-smoker beside him laughs once, without humor, and pulls her sack closer.
